name: ga4gh-service-registry skill
summary: List services registered with a configured GA4GH Service Registry, optionally filtered by GA4GH service type, or retrieve one registered service by id
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Service Registry, shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-service-registry` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. List services registered with a configured GA4GH Service Registry, optionally filtered by GA4GH service type, or retrieve one registered service by id. Use when the user asks which GA4GH services are registered at a discovery endpoint, wants to find a service of a given GA4GH type (e.g. `tes`, `htsget`), needs the detail of one already-known registered service, or needs to discover GA4GH-compliant services in a deployment.
